answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we utilize Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, agents must lock $500 in collateral to establish a unique identity. Second, every action is logged within a digital atlas of reputation. Third, if an agent acts maliciously, the escrow is forfeited. Fourth, the network burns the bond. An attacker faces $50,000 in bonds and 14 days of intense audit time. This creates a haven for honest actors, even when a gale of fake identities strikes the protocol. It is like a massive stone wall guarding a peaceful village from a sudden, violent flood.
